records.text: Hollywood was founded by gangs, including Jewish mafiosos and bootleggers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Actually, factually speaking, Hollywood was started by gangs. Yes, there were Jewish mafiosos, bootleggers.

verification.notes: Histories of early Hollywood identify predominantly Jewish immigrant entrepreneurs from retail and theater businesses as major studio founders, not gangs or bootleggers. Organized crime later intersected with Hollywood, but that does not support the founding claim.
